svg.title: Deltas pile up like index cards
svg.desc: A day, then a night. Four index cards land on a pile, one at a time. Card 1: John likes ham sandwiches. Card 2 points back at card 1, which is not edited: Actually it was Susan who likes ham sandwiches. John likes BLTs. Card 3: Susan is John's wife. That night the digest pass adds card 4, a consolidation card with an amber header: John likes BLTs. Susan, his wife, likes ham sandwiches. It cites cards 1, 2 and 3, which stay on the pile underneath. It all stays. The summary is just one more card.

g.text: Actually it was Susan who likes ham
John likes BLTs. Susan, his wife,
